text:
emily: Heads-up from a large telco pilot: they need 6y immutable audit, BYOK with HSM attestation, and a legal-hold API that can lock phone-call transcripts across regions. They also want a record of any re-identification and who approved it.
raj: For cost reasons we should default to searchable metadata + payload in cold WORM storage. Provide an expedited restore option for customers who pay.
sara: Compliance: auditors expect the key not be under our control. Envelope encryption where the customer KMS unwraps per-tenant keys at restore time is the right pattern. Also need signed manifests with SHA256 and a replay-proof timestamp.
tom: Engineering constraints: cross-region holds require a consistent global state. Proposal: hold-index in control plane (append-only), snapshot job that writes manifests per region, manifest signed by HSM key, store in cold archive.
emily: Proposed minimal launch criteria:
  - tenant-level BYOK mode (customer-managed KMS)
  - retention profiles: metadata searchable 6y, payload cold 180d (configurable)
  - legal-hold API with snapshot + signed manifest returned
  - re-identification flow requires explicit approval and emits audit record with key attestation
raj: Quick API sketch:
  POST /admin/tenants/:id/policy {"retention":"cold-6y","byok":"enforced","legal_hold":true}
  POST /admin/tenants/:id/legal_hold/snapshot {"label":"telco-audit-2026"}
sara: Acceptance tests: create hold, run snapshot, verify manifest signature and timestamp, simulate restore where customer KMS unwraps and verify attestation string.
infra-bot: Note: we have scheduled archival maintenance tonight 23:00 UTC; snapshots during this window may fail.
tom: Action items:
  - emily: PRD sketch with gating and cost appendix (due Mon)
  - raj: spike envelope-BYOK restore flow + cost estimate for cold vs hot per TB (2w)
  - sara: compliance test harness and evidence checklist (2w)
  - infra: ensure hold-index HA and snapshot retries (infra team)
emily: Let's reconvene after spikes and decide default retention tiers and paid expediting options. :rocket:
